_comment: Company handles per applicant tracking system. Add or remove freely: each one is a public job board endpoint. Find a handle by opening a company's careers page and reading the URL, for example boards.greenhouse.io/<handle> or jobs.lever.co/<handle>.

notes.how_to_add: Run: ./run boards add <provider> <handle>. It checks the board answers before saving.
notes.verified: Every handle here was confirmed to return open roles. Dead handles were removed because each one costs a slow, failing request on every run.
notes.african_focus: moniepoint (greenhouse) and andela (ashby) hire across Africa and remotely.
notes.remote_first: gitlab, canonical, posthog, supabase, railway, resend and vercel are remote first.
